name: LiteAnyStereo V2
plain: LiteAnyStereo V2, an efficient zero-shot stereo family in sizes S, M, L and H.
summary: LiteAnyStereo V2: efficient zero-shot stereo with FasterNet-T0 features, a correlation volume and FasterNet 2-D cost aggregation (sizes S / M / L), or a group-wise volume with a selective-GRU update (H).

papers.title: Lite Any Stereo V2: Faster and Stronger Efficient Zero-Shot Stereo Matching

licence_notes: Trained on a mixture that includes NVIDIA's FSD dataset and Dynamic Replica, whose terms for commercial use of trained models are unclear (the repository lists no data terms); the status does not depend on the training data.
limitations: The original code's LAS1 (LiteAnyStereo.pth, another architecture) is not included.
Portable LAS2-H is faster than the original code but allocates more memory.
task_io: Input: a rectified left / right image pair. Output: a disparity map (pixels, left view).
